units.source_text: 柏木死后举办法事，非常庄严隆重，与寻常世俗迥不相同。

en.t: After Kashiwagi's death, memorial rites were held for him with extraordinary solemnity and grandeur, entirely unlike ordinary worldly ceremonies.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将的夫人云居雁自不必说，夕雾自己也特地延请高僧，

en.t: Not only did General Yugiri's wife, Kumoi no Kari, take part, but Yugiri himself also made a special effort to invite eminent monks,

units.source_text: 为柏木诵经念佛，排场十分盛大。

en.t: so that they might chant sutras and recite prayers for Kashiwagi; the whole affair was arranged on a very grand scale.

units.source_text: 此后夕雾常赴一条院访问。

en.t: After that, Yugiri often went to visit the Ichijo residence.

units.source_text: 时惟四月，晴空万里，清和宜人。

en.t: It was April, with clear skies stretching endlessly, and the air was fresh, gentle, and pleasant.

units.source_text: 四处树梢，一色青葱，美好可爱。

en.t: The treetops everywhere were uniformly lush and green, beautiful and charming to behold.

units.source_text: 惟一条院邸内日夜悲叹，处处萧条岑寂。

en.t: Only within the Ichijo residence did grief continue day and night, and every corner felt desolate and silent.

units.source_text: 正在度日如年之时，夕雾大将照例前来访问了。

en.t: At a time when each day seemed to drag on like a year, General Yugiri came to visit as usual.

units.source_text: 但见庭中一片嫩草，正在青青发芽。

en.t: He saw that the garden was covered with tender young grasses, now sprouting in fresh green.

units.source_text: 铺沙较少的荫处，蓬蒿也正欣欣向荣。

en.t: In the shaded places where little sand had been spread, mugwort and other wild growth were also flourishing vigorously.

units.source_text: 柏木生前爱好栽花种树，现在这些花木无人管理，任意地繁殖着。

en.t: In life, Kashiwagi had loved planting flowers and trees; now, with no one to tend them, these plants were spreading freely on their own.

units.source_text: “一丛芭芒草”也得势滋蔓，想象将来虫声繁密的秋趣，令人感慨流泪。

en.t: Even the clump of pampas grass was gaining strength and spreading, and the thought of autumn to come, dense with insect cries, moved one to tears.

units.source_text: 夕雾就在这些露草之间缓步而入。

en.t: Yugiri slowly made his way in among these dew-laden grasses.

units.source_text: 檐前处处挂着伊豫帘，里面的淡墨色帷屏已经换上夏季的薄纱，

en.t: Iyo blinds hung here and there before the eaves, and inside, the pale ink-colored curtains had already been changed to thin summer gauze,

units.source_text: 透过帘影眺望，颇有凉爽之感。

en.t: so that when one looked through the shadow of the blinds, there was a distinctly cool feeling.

units.source_text: 内有几个姣好的女童，穿着浓墨色上衣。

en.t: Inside were several pretty young attendant girls, wearing jackets of deep ink black.

units.source_text: 从帘外隐约窥见她们的衣裾和面影，样子非常可爱，然而这种颜色毕竟触目惊心。

en.t: From outside the blinds, their hems and faces could be glimpsed faintly; they looked very charming, yet that color was still painful to the eye.
